My dear [Lord Bishop](/person/722)
A great many thanks for the poem. I will mark the MS so that the printers should send the proof to you I hope early in January. The story is very touching as you have made it. I wonder how many such tragedies there are going on, unknown.[^1]

I shall always be grateful to it for having brought me your Christmas blessing

With kind regards to [Mrs](/person/721) and [Miss How](/person/2328).

yours respectfully

C M Yonge


[^1]: The story recounted in How\'s poem \'Told at a Village Inn to a Naturalists\' Field Club on a Wet Day (Founded on a Fact)\' MP (February 1885), 101-9, concerns the younger son of a squire, clandestinely married to the vicar\'s daughter, who dies in America unbeknownst to his family.
